title: China dangles bounty for Taiwan PsyOps unit
description: BEIJING/TAIPEI—Chinese police on Saturday offered rewards of $1,400 for information about 18 people it said were Taiwanese military psychological operations officers spreading “separatist” messages, a day after Taiwan pledged to boost its defenses.

title: China Issues Bounty for Taiwan Psyops Unit for 'Separatism'
description: The public security bureau in the Chinese city of Xiamen, which sits opposite Taiwan on the other side of the Taiwan Strait, said the 18 were core members of the Taiwanese military's psychological warfare unit and published their pictures, names, and Taiwan identity card numbers.

title: Taiwan Analyst Denies Feasibility of Chinese Naval Blockade
description: A top Taiwanese defence analyst has dismissed claims that China could blockade Taiwan using just a few submarines. Expert Alexander Huang called the plan logistically flawed and strategically risky, sparking debate among officials and questioning the realism of such military tactics.

title: Taiwan experts dismiss claims that China could blockade island with few submarines
